## EIN overview

::: {.lead}
EIN brings the people and the place for the Swedish pilot.
:::

::: {.flow .ovw}
::: {.node}
<b>Who they are</b>A Swedish non-profit that runs the ElectriCITY innovation ecosystem in Hammarby Sjöstad.
:::
<div class="arrow"></div>
::: {.node .hot}
<b>What they do here</b>Host the Swedish pilot, run the Living Lab, and involve citizens and operators in the design.
:::
<div class="arrow"></div>
::: {.node}
<b>What the project gets</b>A real operating environment, and people who will use the tools.
:::
:::

::: {.facts}
::: {.fact}
<b>24.0 person-months</b>in total, over 36 months
:::
::: {.fact}
<b>12.0 in WP6</b>the largest effort of any partner there
:::
::: {.fact}
<b>2 002 182 SEK</b>national funding, 100%
:::
:::

::: {.notes}
Source: the international proposal, partner table and section 3.2, and the Swedish proposal for the funding.
In the proposal EIN is named ElectriCITY Innovation, and in a few places Electricity Innovation. It is the same partner.
The facts row: WP6 is 12.0 of 24.0 person-months. In WP6, EIN has more effort than KTH (10.0) and IMT (10.0).
:::

## The Swedish pilot

::: {.lead}
EIN hosts the pilot for the operator decision-support use case (EDCR), in Hammarby Sjöstad.
:::

::: {.steps}
::: {.step}
<b>Real data</b><br>Community and building data from the district, with ProptechOS supplying building streams.
:::
::: {.step}
<b>Simulated grid limits</b><br>Informed by the grid operator (DSO), since the project does not control the real grid.
:::
::: {.step}
<b>Shadow mode</b><br>The assistant suggests, for example for load peaks or flexibility activation. Operators decide.
:::
:::

::: {.notes}
The proposal describes this pilot in more detail than the others. Task T6.2, led by KTH, with EIN, ProptechOS, TRI and IMT.
Key sentence: nothing in the pilot controls a physical asset.
Likely question: who are the operators? Open. See the last slide.
:::

## EIN in WP3: the user side of the requirements

::: {.cols}
::: {.col .ecp}
<span class="tag">T3.1 Blueprints</span>

Stakeholders and requirements for the Swedish pilot.

Co-design workshops with the Living Lab method, including non-expert users.
:::
::: {.col .edcr}
<span class="tag">T3.2 KPIs and validation</span>

Review of the T3.1 results with stakeholders.

Input to the KPIs and the impact planning.
:::
::: {.col .esla}
<span class="tag">Effort</span>

7.0 person-months in M01 to M09, the second largest after KTH.

Stakeholders for the pilot, proposed by M02.
:::
:::

::: {.notes}
Details: the international proposal (T3.1, T3.2) and the WP3 guide. The split of tasks in this slide is a summary, the workshops and the stakeholder map are in T3.1. "Stakeholders by M02" is the proposal in our WP3 deck, still to be agreed.
EIN's input is what keeps the requirements about real use, not about what is technically convenient.
:::

## EIN in WP6: running the pilot

::: {.cols}
::: {.col .edcr}
<span class="tag">Before the pilot</span>

Name a pilot coordinator.

Arrange operators and users, and agree a schedule early.

Help measure today's baselines.
:::
::: {.col .edcr}
<span class="tag">During the pilot</span>

Host sessions with operators in shadow mode.

Replay past events with them.

Collect feedback and survey answers.
:::
::: {.col .edcr}
<span class="tag">After the pilot</span>

Take part in the analysis.

Help assess the impact for the Swedish case.
:::
:::

::: {.notes}
Biggest risk from the WP6 risk list: operators have little time for shadow-mode sessions. The mitigation is to agree a schedule with EIN and the DSO early, replay historical events and keep the sessions short.
The pilot period is short, about four months between the beta at M30 and the analysis phase from M34.
:::

## Beyond the pilot

::: {.lead}
EIN also opens doors in Sweden.
:::

- **Access.** Direct contact with Swedish energy communities and with DSO innovation programmes.
- **Community playbook.** EIN organises a workshop for Swedish energy communities and DSOs.
- **After the project.** EIN drives market validation in Sweden, as part of the exploitation plan.

::: {.notes}
From the impact and dissemination sections of the proposal. The workshop is one of the national dissemination events, one per pilot country.
No dates are given in the proposal for the workshop.
:::
